units.source_text: 我总觉得这趟被煤烟熏黑的破旧列车不是开往古都，

en.t: I always felt that this shabby old train, blackened by coal smoke, was not heading toward the ancient capital,

units.source_text: 而仿佛是驶向死亡的车站。

en.t: but seemed instead to be running toward a station of death.

units.source_text: 如是想，每次经过隧道时弥漫在车厢内的煤烟，

en.t: Thinking this, every time we passed through a tunnel, the coal smoke that filled the carriage

units.source_text: 便都发出一种火葬场的气味儿。

en.t: seemed to give off the smell of a crematorium.
